sections.text:
The electro hydraulic 
converter - Module EHP12 for steam turbine 
control - consists of two parts: 
electromechanical and hydraulic part.

EHP12 module convert the electrical signal (mA) "out put of module A10 inside 
cabinet JCO1" to a mechanical signal to control the hydraulic oil pressure for 
high and medium turbine (control the ratio of opening the load valves).

This document outlines the testing procedure P1, which performed every six 
months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, tested by
 eng. Ashraf Farid at 20 May 2003, revised 
by quality control EDEPCo. eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, accepted by general 
director: eng. Aly Abd El-Whab, and approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy; Head 
Sector of Talkha Power Station.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should be carry the
 suitable safety category,

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,

Wear your safety helmet, shoes
 . etc

Connect jumper between point x20:90 and 
 point x20:97 in rear control cabinet side NO: JC02
 (Imitation condition: phased ON)

Disconnect point (x20:108) in rear control cabinet side JC02 (Imitation 
 condition: tripe oil OK)

Disconnect socket 
 of card A31+54 
 type A2121B1 
 in front control cabinet JC03 (Imitation: digital speed)

Press switch S1 on card A23+76
 type 
 D6209B1
 in front control cabinet JC02 
 (condition: Basic mode)

Connect jumper between point X20:90 and 
 point x20:110 in rear control cabinet side JC02 (Imitation condition: limiter 
 > limit).

Change variable resistance R1 in front card A10+60 type A2804B1 to 
 adjust the o/p signal on point A10+60:10,11 to 26v and 
 put the control valves 1,2,3,4 in zero 
 position.

Make valves (1,2,3,4) completely open 
 (100%) and check the o/p voltage at point A10+60:11,10 must be 6.3 Vdc if not 
 ok adjust from r2 in front card A10+60 type A2804B1

Make the valves again to zero position if 
 the o/p voltage not equal 26 then readjust the variable resistance R1 
 .
Repeat steeps 6, 7, 8 up to no change.

Remove Jumper between point X20:90 and 
 point X20:97.

Connect Signal (trip oil not ok) X20 
 :108.

Remove Jumper between point X20:90 and 
 point X20:110.

Introduction

converter - Module EHP12 for steam turbine

electromechanical and hydraulic part.
EHP12 module convert the electrical signal (mA) "out put of module A10 inside 
cabinet JCO1" to a mechanical signal to control the hydraulic oil pressure for 
high and medium turbine (control the ratio of opening the load valves).
